purpose: Estimate the H curve work removable by forming a point sum once for multiple equal nonzero digit columns.
models: two ranges, full columns first without short-column selection
two ranges, full columns then short-column selection
one hypothetical range, full columns then short-column selection
selection: Each generation pairs consecutive available rows in equal digit-pair classes in fixed column order. A row is used at most once per generation. Reuse all matching nonzero digits in an admitted pair.
metrics: Formation uses one point addition. Residual arrivals, bucket occupancy and exact scalar reconstruction are validated. One-generation full-column class tickets and eligible short-column rows are optimistic allowance for disjoint pairs only.
limitation: Unweighted generic group-operation counts, excluding packing, recoding, task ordering, point lifetimes, and wall time. No latency claim. The independent verifier accepts every exported proof from the capture processes.
interpretation: Prioritize a curve-work prototype if the fixed two-range schedule removes at least ten percent of the original H generic bucket-accumulation additions on both inputs before charging routing or memory overhead.
